_about: Time-boxed or standing offers worth money to someone paying for LLM inference. Each entry says what, for whom, until when, where it was seen, and how well it was verified. `verified` = checked on the provider's own page on that date; `asserted` = seen only in third-party reporting. Expired entries stay (with `expires` in the past) so the feed can show what was missed. Updated via PR.

deals.title: Max plans now include monthly Claude Platform API credits
deals.detail: $100/month on Max 5x, $200/month on Max 20x, Team seats $20 (Standard) or $100 (Premium) into a shared pool. Claim once in claude.ai (web) by linking a Console org, after 7 days on the plan. No rollover. Not usable for interactive Claude Code.
deals.source: Anthropic announcement 7 Oct 2026 via apidog.com, developersdigest.tech, aicatchup.com (29 Oct 2026)

deals.title: Gemini API launch pricing ends 30 Nov: $3.60/$10 becomes $7.20/$20 per 1M
deals.detail: One Gemini model's paid tier is at half price through 30 Nov 2026 and doubles on 1 Dec. A second model is $0.75/$3.75 through 31 Dec, then $1.50/$7.50 on 1 Jan 2027 (context caching $0.075 → doubles too). Front-load eval and batch work before the step.
deals.source: ai.google.dev pricing page excerpt via Parallel search, 28 Oct 2026

deals.title: Three new :free models on OpenRouter this month
deals.detail: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free (1M context, 15 Oct), xingchen-agi/xing4.0-29b-a4b:free (16 Oct), recursive/flint-v1.0:free (21 Oct). Free tier: 50 requests/day, 1,000/day after a one-time $10 top-up, 20/min.
deals.data_terms: NVIDIA-hosted free models may train on prompts; check each listing's data policy.

deals.title: stealth/glyph-cluster free via Kilo Code since 27 Oct
deals.detail: Anonymous preview model served free through Kilo Code. Stealth previews usually last one to two weeks and the provider may use prompts to improve the model.
deals.source: freellm.net changelog via Parallel search, 29 Oct 2026
deals.data_terms: Stealth program default: prompts and completions may be used to train and evaluate the model.

deals.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash free inside OpenCode (200K context)
deals.detail: Calls to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in the OpenCode agent no longer draw plan credits, since 16 Oct 2026. Context capped at 200K (1M on the paid model). DeepSeek's own API has no free tier.

deals.title: Qoder: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash free until 1 Nov, plus 100 credits/day
deals.detail: 100 free credits a day (claim daily, each valid 30 days), free Qwen3.8-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 free until 1 Nov 00:00 UTC+8. Sign-up required.

deals.title: Novita batch inference at an introductory 50% off
deals.detail: Batch input and output tokens at half price on supported models, labelled introductory with no end date. Worth it for eval runs and backfills on open models.

deals.title: Fireworks adds 50% to serverless models marked US-only (since 1 Sep)
deals.detail: A price increase, not a deal: region-restricted deployments cost 1.5x. If you pinned a US-only endpoint on Fireworks, re-check the rate or route elsewhere.

deals.title: Claude Batch API: 50% off input and output on every model
deals.detail: Asynchronous, results within 24h. Also exposed on OpenRouter as :batch variants (fable-5.1 $5/$25, opus-5.5 $2/$10, sonnet-5.5 $1/$5). The lever for evals, backfills and anything not interactive.

deals.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash free on OpenRouter for 72 hours (19–22 Oct)
deals.detail: The stealth model 'Space Bunny' (200T tokens in stealth, OpenRouter's #1 for 10 days) returned as MiniMax M3.1 Flash, free for 72h, then $0.15/$0.60 per 1M, cached input $0.015.
deals.source: OpenRouter and MiniMax on X, 19 Oct 2026; unite.ai
